Liverpool FC (officially: Liverpool Football Club) – also known as The Reds – is a football club from Liverpool founded in 1892. With 18 league titles, Liverpool FC is one of England’s most successful clubs. The club has also won the FA Cup seven times and the League Cup eight times. On the European stage, the club has won the European Cup / UEFA Champions League six times and the UEFA Cup three times. Since its founding, Liverpool FC has played at Anfield Stadium. Liverpool has a large and loyal fan base. The club’s supporters were involved in two major disasters in European football: in 1985, Liverpool supporters caused a mass panic in the Heysel disaster that killed 39 Juventus fans. In 1989, 96 Liverpool supporters died in the Hillsborough disaster in Sheffield after police opened an exit gate that allowed uncontrolled access to two stands. Liverpool FC has long-standing rivalries with local neighbours Everton FC (the Merseyside Derby) and Manchester United.

Liverpool FC (officially: Liverpool Football Club) – also known as The Reds – is a football club from Liverpool founded in 1892. With 18 league titles, Liverpool FC is one of England’s most successful clubs. The club has also won the FA Cup seven times and the League Cup eight times. On the European stage, the club has won the European Cup / UEFA Champions League six times and the UEFA Cup three times. Since its founding, Liverpool FC has played at Anfield Stadium. Liverpool has a large and loyal fan base. The club’s supporters were involved in two major disasters in European football: in 1985, Liverpool supporters caused a mass panic in the Heysel disaster that killed 39 Juventus fans. In 1989, 96 Liverpool supporters died in the Hillsborough disaster in Sheffield after police opened an exit gate that allowed uncontrolled access to two stands. Liverpool FC has long-standing rivalries with local neighbours Everton FC (the Merseyside Derby) and Manchester United.
